An '''Imperial warlord''' was a member of the [[Shadow Council (Imperial Remnants)|Shadow Council]] during the [[New Republic Era]], attending a [[Hologram|holographic]] meeting held by the subversive confederacy of [[Imperial Remnants]] in [[Mandalore Imperial base|an Imperial base]] situated on the [[planet]] [[Mandalore]], where they listened without comment to the discussions made by other [[warlord]]s over their separate goals and beliefs, acknowledging the presence of [[Moff]] [[Gideon]] when he arrived to the meeting and considering the Moff's observation regarding how the [[Unknown Regions Imperial remnant|separate]] [[Gilad Pellaeon's delegation|factions]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] represented by [[Commandant]] [[Brendol Hux]] and [[Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon]] continued to amass countless resources they horded for their own respective ends, namely the completion of [[Project Necromancer]] and the return of the lost [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]]. They wore [[Imperial Army trooper armor]].<ref name="Chapter 23: The Spies" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The warlord first appeared in "[[Chapter 23: The Spies]]," the seventh episode of [[The Mandalorian Season Three|season three]] of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'' which was released on [[April 12]], [[2023]].<ref name="S3 Dates">{{Twitter|starwars|status/1598416900689743873|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-12-1|quote=The Mandalorian and Grogu return March 1 only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/ytQHE}}</ref> The warlord was portrayed by [[Ron Bottitta]].<ref name="Chapter 23: The Spies" />
